basic_info.description: Open the door to what is one of the most iconic views in the world: a panoramic unobstructed view of the San Francisco Bay from the East Bay hills all the way to the Golden Gate Bridge and beyond. This spacious light-filled abode features an exceptional open floorplan design that takes full advantage of its North and West views with two walls of windows to capture its iconically spectacular setting. Enjoy sweeping views of the shimmering waters of the Bay and overlooking world-renowned Ghirardelli Square with its famous sign and historic sailing ships- and framed with the beautiful greenery of the new Francisco Park in the foreground from the comfort of your living room and own private balcony. Featuring a luxurious primary suite, powder room and a spectacular entertaining/ dining/ living/ kitchen great room, this is a wonderful home to enjoy a quintessentially urban lifestyle close to the City's wonderful waterfront attractions.
